goalZh: 读懂一串按时间排列的短信,说出发信人几点在做什么,学会补全短信里省略的部分
canDoZh: 能读懂一串按时间排列的短信,说出发信人一天里几点在做什么

newItems.noteZh: gh 读 /f/,a 读 /æ/;笑出声用 laugh,微笑是 smile。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's Saturday, and Lei is at the library.
lines.zh: 周六,磊在图书馆。他的手机一整天响个不停,都是伊森发来的消息。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Good morning, roommate! It's 11:30. That's early for me!
lines.zh: (11:30)早上好,室友!现在十一点半。对我来说这算早的!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Breakfast at noon, and the gym at two.

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: At the gym now. I work out five times a week!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Lei, where are you? At the library again?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, Ethan. I sometimes study here on Saturdays.
lines.zh: (磊回复)是啊,伊森。我周六有时候在这儿学习。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: It's five o'clock. Video games at eight? You and me, man!
lines.zh: (17:00)五点了。八点打游戏?就咱俩,哥们儿!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sure! But I go to bed at eleven.
lines.zh: (磊回复)行啊!不过我十一点就睡觉。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Eleven? That's early! I go to bed at three!
lines.zh: 十一点?那也太早了!我三点才睡!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Seven o'clock! Dinner time, Lei! Hurry up!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lei laughs. His roommate is really funny!
lines.zh: 磊看着一条条消息,笑了。他这个室友真逗!

questions.prompt: 伊森几点发来第一条消息?
questions.explainZh: 伊森说 It's 11:30. That's early for me!(现在十一点半,对我来说这算早的!)

questions.prompt: 伊森一周去几次健身房?
questions.explainZh: 伊森在健身房发消息说 I work out five times a week!(我一周练五次!)
磊说自己十一点睡,伊森说 Eleven? That's early! I go to bed at three!(我三点才睡!)

grammar.titleZh: 读短信:补全省略的部分;一般现在时说习惯
grammar.bodyZh: 短信、聊天消息常常把主语和动词省掉,读的时候自己补全:At the gym now. = I'm at the gym now.(我在健身房呢);Breakfast at noon. = I have breakfast at noon.(中午吃早饭);Video games at eight? = 八点打游戏吗?(是在邀请你)。说每天、每周都这样的习惯用一般现在时:I work out five times a week.、I go to bed at three.;说别人的习惯,动词加 -s:Ethan works out five times a week.。读一串消息时,先看每条的时间,再看他在做什么。

examples.zh: 在健身房呢。(完整的句子是 I'm at the gym now.)

examples.text: I work out five times a week.
Ethan goes to bed at three.
